info.title: Restaurant Management API
info.description:
API to manage users, categories, menu items and orders of a restaurant (CSE 341 final project).

**How to log in:** open `/auth/github` in the browser and sign in with GitHub. The session cookie is saved automatically, so the "Try it out" buttons in this page will work as a logged-in user.

**Roles:** `customer` (default), `staff`, `admin`.

**Errors:** invalid data returns 400, missing login 401, wrong role 403, not found 404, duplicates 409 and unexpected server errors 500.

get.summary: Log in with GitHub (open this URL in the browser)

post.description: Only admins can create or delete users.

put.description: Users can edit their own displayName, email and phone. Admins can edit everything (including role).

post.description: Any logged-in user can create an order (total is calculated by the server).

put.description: Customers can change or cancel their own PENDING orders. Staff/admin can change anything, including status.

delete.description: Customers can delete their own pending orders. Staff/admin can delete any order.
